title: stainless steel ice bucket
text: stainless steel ice bucket. Bought for a small dinner party and it was PERFECT.  Kept ice in a 75 degree room for more than 8 hours.  It's nice looking, stainless steel.  Not really huge, I believe the ad says 3 liters and that looks about right... There is a slotted plate in the bottom that keeps the ice from slushing around in melting water.  It does appear to be double walled.  The tongs are probably the least of it - they are bit tinny... but they work. I hand wash. I will update if new info would seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Bellemain Stainless Steel Ice Bucket with Lid - Double Wall Insulated Ice Bucket for Cocktail Bar, Parties, Buffet - Bartender Ice Cube Holder with Drip Tray, Tongs - 3 Liter Large Ice Container
features: STAINLESS STEEL | PERFECT FOR ANY PARTY: In any décor, the details matter. Bellemain presents an ice bucket designed beautifully enough to sit at any table—sized for convenience, and made with robust stainless steel to prevent rusting because impressing people is fun.

PROTECT YOUR TABLE FROM WET MESSES: We were tired of ice buckets that create condensation outside, creating moisture rings on the bottom that can damage floors and tables. Designed by the best engineers, our ice bucket prevents condensation on the outside so that you can take it anywhere without a watery puddle forming.
EXTRA-LONG CHILL TIME | 6 FULL FROSTY HOURS: Double wall insulation keeps your wine, champagne, and beer at the ideal drinking temperature. Nothing beats a cold drink.

BONUS | BARTENDER’S “NO MESS” PRECISION ICE TONGS: Pick up these smooth, classically designed stainless steel ice tongs. They will make the perfect addition to your bar equipment. It is ideal for parties and events, so you can quickly transfer cubes to cocktails and other iced drinks with no mess or ice burns.

FITS EVERYTHING YOU NEED | 3-LITRE CAPACITY: This classic yet modern design is big enough to hold your favorite drinks and portable enough to go anywhere. Just grab its quick-grab handles, and you’re off to the party. Not dishwasher safe.
